integrity: Finite exhaustive checks are corroboration, not a substitute for the all-size circulation, transfer-matrix and spectral argument. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The count determines extinction, not recurrent attractor classes among persistent states; the asymptotic uses a previously proved general finite-graph circulation criterion. Historic 1978 and 1993 full texts were not available for complete comparison.
title: Exact extinction law and a Gaussian winding penalty for excitation on circular prisms
